sources.summary: The new office building by Wido Arquitectos explores how monumentality can emerge in a compact lot of 5.00 x 15.00 meters, presenting an architectural gesture that asserts itself in the city with sobriety and strength. The project, located in Cuernavaca , Morelos, transforms spatial restriction into a creative opportunity.
